blocks.content: Wise or Foolish?
叙事阅读与写作 · A Storybook Lesson
Today we open a real story and ask one question: was the choice wise or foolish? You will read, judge, and write an analysis paragraph. 今天，我们一起翻开一个真实的故事，判断主人公的选择是明智还是愚蠢，并写出一段有理有据的分析。
本课任务：读懂故事 → 做出判断 → 写出分析段落（Read → Judge → Write）

slides.speaker_notes: 用故事口吻开场：今天我们要翻开一个真实故事，判断主人公的选择。翻开故事书第一页，介绍本课三个任务：读故事、做判断、写分析。
slides.title: Wise or Foolish?

blocks.content: Once upon a time — in a very real life — someone stood at a fork in the road. Step into their shoes. 很久以前，就在很真实的生活里，有人站在了岔路口。先设想你站在他的位置。
A big reward comes with a big risk — what would you do? 巨大回报伴随巨大风险，你会怎么做？

content: Every story has a decision point. 每个故事都有抉择时刻。
A choice leads to consequences. 选择带来后果。
Our job: judge it with evidence. 用证据做判断。

slides.speaker_notes: 提问：如果是你，会怎么做？先不给出结论。
slides.title: The Story Opens…

blocks.content: The Real Case: Nadia's Choice
Nadia, a 17-year-old swimmer, trained three years for the national championships. The final fell on her grandmother's 80th birthday — the grandmother who raised her. Nadia chose the birthday.
blocks.source_ref: Lesson narrative material (adapted for class use)

blocks.content: Decision 决定：family over competition. Consequence 后果：missed the nationals.
wise 明智的 · foolish 愚蠢的 · decision 决定 · consequence 后果 · evidence 证据

slides.speaker_notes: 圈画 decision 与 consequence 关键句；解释核心词汇。
slides.title: The Real Case: A Fateful Choice

blocks.content: Was Nadia's choice wise or foolish? What evidence do you need? 判断需要什么证据？

Wise 明智 | Foolish 愚蠢
weighs evidence, thinks long-term 权衡证据、着眼长远 | ignores evidence, rushes 忽视证据、冲动行事
takes responsibility 勇于担当 | blames others 推卸责任

content: Find facts in the text. 从文中找事实。
What did Nadia know then? 她当时知道什么？
What happened next? 后来发生了什么？

slides.speaker_notes: 对比判断标准，完成证据清单；不给出唯一结论。
slides.title: Wise or Foolish? Making a Judgement

blocks.content: A strong analysis paragraph = Claim + Evidence + Commentary. 一个有力的分析段落 = 观点 + 证据 + 阐释。

content: Claim 观点：state your judgement in one clear sentence. 用一句话亮明你的判断。
Evidence 证据：give facts or short quotes from the text. 引用文中的事实或短句。
Commentary 阐释：explain why the evidence supports your claim. 解释证据为何支持你的观点。

blocks.content: Use linkers to connect ideas: in my view, on the other hand, as a result. 用连接词让逻辑更清晰：在我看来、另一方面、因此。

slides.speaker_notes: 讲解 C-E-C 三步结构及连接词用法，给出中英对照示例；强调顺序：先观点、再证据、后阐释。
slides.title: The Analysis Paragraph: Claim–Evidence–Commentary

blocks.content: A Model: The Grasshopper's Choice
In my view, the grasshopper's choice was foolish: he sang all summer while the ant stored food, so he starved in winter. Planning ahead matters more than pleasure.

content: Claim 观点：the choice was foolish.
Evidence 证据：sang all summer; the ant stored food.
Commentary 阐释：pleasure led to hunger.

blocks.content: Structure only — your judgement is yours. 只示范结构，判断由你论证。

slides.speaker_notes: 示范只展示结构，不替代学生对 Nadia 的判断；标注 C-E-C 三处。
slides.title: A Model Analysis Paragraph

blocks.content: Write one paragraph (80–100 words): Was Nadia's choice wise or foolish? Use Claim–Evidence–Commentary. 写一段 80–100 词的分析。

content: Start with a clear claim. 先亮明观点。
Give two pieces of evidence. 给两条证据。
Explain why they matter. 解释证据为何重要。
Use one linker: in my view / as a result. 至少用一个连接词。

blocks.content: Either judgement is fine — evidence matters most. 两种判断皆可，证据最重要。

slides.speaker_notes: 明确字数与时间（约 8 分钟）；巡视并提供支架。
slides.title: Your Turn: Write Your Analysis

blocks.content: Read your partner's paragraph. Does it convince you? 读一读同伴的段落：它说服你了吗？

content: Claim 观点：Is the judgement clear and stated first? 判断是否明确且放在开头？
Evidence 证据：Are there at least two pieces of evidence? 是否有至少两条证据？
Commentary 阐释：Does the writer explain why the evidence matters? 是否解释了证据的重要性？
Language 语言：Are linkers used correctly? 连接词使用是否正确？

blocks.content: Give one strength and one suggestion. 给同伴一个优点和一个改进建议。

slides.speaker_notes: 按清单互评：观点是否明确、证据是否充分、阐释是否到位；提醒先肯定优点再提建议。
slides.title: Peer Review Checklist

blocks.content: Read stories to judge real choices: look for evidence, weigh consequences, then decide. 读故事，学判断：找证据、看后果、下判断。

content: A choice has reasons and consequences. 选择有原因，也有后果。
A judgement needs evidence. 判断需要证据。
A strong paragraph: Claim + Evidence + Commentary. 有力的段落：观点 + 证据 + 阐释。

blocks.content: The end of one story is the beginning of your own — your analysis, your judgement. 一个故事的结束，是你自己故事的开始。你的分析，由你判断。

slides.speaker_notes: 回顾 C-E-C 框架与证据意识；布置课后作业：写一段分析，判断你自己或身边一个真实选择是 wise 还是 foolish，并用证据支撑。
slides.title: Storybook Ending: What We Learned
